title: Constitution of the circle (v1): clauses consolidated from the governing documents that already exist
principle: No clause here is new authority. Each is a citation of an existing source, given an id so it can be checked. Where sources conflict the conflict is a clause with enforcement kind 'conflict'.

statuses.DECLARED: stated; no mechanism or check exists
statuses.IMPLEMENTED: a mechanism exists; no check ran in the recorded run
statuses.TESTED: its checks passed against a live circle in the recorded run
statuses.FAILED: at least one of its checks failed in the recorded run
statuses.EXTERNAL: enforced by another system's own tests; cited

path: amendment proposal (POST /constitution/amendments; stored as a PURL resource of type 'amendment', status 'proposed')
authorized adoption: a human-authored git commit to this file
constitution_vN+1 (version = content hash of this file)
the_circle_cannot: change a clause's status by hand

clauses.text: A GET never changes state. Preparing is not performing.

enforcement.mechanism: GET handlers are pure functions of upstream state; mutations exist only under POST
session_id is declared by the caller and recorded with assurance 'asserted'; the circle never infers it
a new version of someone's scroll is a fork owned by the forker; the parent is never written
the circle holds no ACSP capability and submits only propose
enforced and tested by ACSP itself (harness scenario handoff); the circle performs no handoff

clauses.interpretation: Not exercised by the circle. Its status is ACSP's, cited, not re-derived here.

clauses.text: Possessing a URL never confers mutation authority; credentials never travel in URLs.

enforcement.mechanism: requests carrying cap/token/capability query parameters are refused with 400

clauses.text: Capability secrets never appear in logs or records.

enforcement.mechanism: secrets are held in process memory only; a scan of every persisted record finds none

clauses.text: Prepared is not submitted; submitted is not committed.

enforcement.mechanism: every ACSP step reports its stage; the circle can reach 'submitted' at most

clauses.text: Executing a model produces SIMULATED or computational results, never OBSERVED.

enforcement.mechanism: epistemic labels are copied from the substrate, never set by the circle; no record claims OBSERVED

clauses.text: An unavailable capability is reported as unavailable; no result is substituted.

enforcement.mechanism: adapter returns unavailable_here (503) when the system is unreachable

clauses.text: One canonical value has one value identity, whoever computes it; the records of computing it stay separate.

enforcement.mechanism: value_id comes from the substrate's canonical value; two builds of equal values share value_id and keep distinct execution records

clauses.text: History is not destroyed: versions, forks and superseded artifacts stay addressable.
source: PURL PRINCIPLES (forking does not destroy lineage; supersession does not require deletion)

enforcement.mechanism: scroll versions are PURL forks; the parent remains resolvable and verifiable

clauses.text: The constitution changes only through an explicit amendment path; it is never rewritten by the system it governs.

enforcement.mechanism: the circle exposes no write to the constitution; amendments are stored as proposals; adoption is a human-authored git commit whose hash becomes the new version

clauses.text: The SEURL vocabulary is finite: START SWITCH WRITE COMMIT BUILD TALK PERTURB.

enforcement.mechanism: unknown upper-case verbs are refused; illegal transitions are refused with the legal set

clauses.text: An agent-facing page offers structures (legal moves), not prose.

enforcement.mechanism: every circle document carries machine-readable moves {rel, method, href}

clauses.text: No automation of third-party AI or browser providers.

enforcement.mechanism: adapters reach only configured endpoints of our own services; reviewed in code

clauses.text: A browser or phone is a client of the substrate, never its source of truth.

enforcement.mechanism: the Golden Surface adapter has no write path into scrolls, values or records

clauses.text: Nothing waits for approval to think, prepare, write, prove or publish within the universe.
clauses.interpretation: CONFLICTS with K-04 and ACSP's owner-resolved proposals when 'publish' means a shared ACSP record: in the circle, preparing, writing, building and proposing never wait; committing to a resource someone else owns does. Unresolved; needs an amendment decision by the operator.

enforcement.mechanism: the circle uses only local processes and existing free deployments
